description: This file defines the CatalogItem class used in a Blazor web application, modeling product catalog items with properties, validation, and image handling methods.

classes.name: CatalogItem
classes.description: Represents an item in the product catalog with properties such as Id, Name, Description, Price, and image data, along with methods for image validation and conversion.

methods.name: IsValidImage
methods.description: Validates the provided image file's name and base64 data against size and format constraints.

methods.name: DataToBase64
methods.description: Asynchronously converts an uploaded file (IFileListEntry) into a base64 string for storage or transmission.

methods.name: IsExtensionValid
methods.description: Checks if the file extension is one of the accepted image formats (.jpg, .png, .gif, .jpeg).
